title: SAVA Aurora R8 R08-R8170-24S current specifications
notes: Current exact R08-R8170-24S manufacturer page claims approximately 8.8 kg, identifies full Shimano Ultegra Di2 2x12, and specifies T800 carbon frame, fork and seatpost with carbon cockpit and wheels. The manufacturer describes exceptional stiffness and power transfer but publishes no numeric stiffness result.
